name: cross-chain-dca
description: Cross-chain DCA template: Hedera DcaOrchestrator schedules recurring swaps executed on Sepolia via Axelar GMP and Uniswap v3.

steps.text: This template deploys contracts to two live testnets — Hedera testnet (chain 296) and Ethereum Sepolia (chain 11155111). It cannot run on a local chain.

steps.label: Copy the env file
steps.text: packages/hardhat/.env.example → packages/hardhat/.env. To change variables manually, edit packages/hardhat/.env directly.

steps.label: Generate or import deployer accounts for both chains
Run the full 10 step-by-step deployment (compile, deploy, wire, fund, create plan, verify)
